en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic riverside view of an industrial city with factory buildings, chimneys, warehouses, and a church spire in the distance. In the foreground is a river or canal with quays and small boats, and an open, grassy bank. The bottom margin contains the printed caption "Tampere - Tammerfors" and the publisher credit, while the rest of the lower area is filled with handwritten correspondence in a cursive script.
